div.div: مُطَرْمِذٌ (S, L, K) and ↓ طِرْمِذَةٌ (K) A man who says but does not act, or perform; (S, L, K;) and who does not act seriously, or in earnest, (لَا يُحَقِّقُ,) in affairs: (K:) or, accord. to some copies of the K, who does not verify things. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
